padding_provenance: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION (0.5 λ0). Source document is silent.
rationale: λ0 = c/f = 299792458 / 3.035e9 = 98.778 mm. A half-wavelength margin around the antenna is a common first-pass HFSS radiation-box size. Closer boxes (λ/4) are cheaper; PML can reduce reflections. Neither is specified by the source.

validation.unintended_overlaps: Must be inspected in the HFSS GUI after the model is built.
validation.disconnected_feed: Feed post spans the assumed gap; inspect union/touch in HFSS.
